import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
sc=bpy.context.scene

def mat(name,col,rough=0.5,metal=0.0):
    m=bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes=True
    b=next(n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type=="BSDF_PRINCIPLED")
    b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value=(*col,1); b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=rough; b.inputs["Metallic"].default_value=metal
    m.diffuse_color=(*col,1)
    return m
M={k:mat(k,*v) for k,v in {
 "Asphalt":((0.05,0.05,0.055),0.9),"Grass":((0.08,0.3,0.06),1.0),"KerbRed":((0.8,0.05,0.03),0.6),
 "KerbWhite":((0.9,0.9,0.9),0.6),"Line":((0.95,0.95,0.95),0.6),
 "CarBody":((0.05,0.35,0.9),0.3,0.4),"CarAccent":((1.0,0.55,0.0),0.4),"Tire":((0.02,0.02,0.02),0.9),
 "Rim":((0.7,0.7,0.72),0.3,1.0),"Glass":((0.02,0.03,0.05),0.1),"Barrier":((0.6,0.6,0.62),0.7)}.items()}

# centerline
R=15.0; L1=40.0; L3=30.0
def center(s):
    if s<=L1: return Vector((0,-L1+s,0)), 0.0
    s2=s-L1; arc=R*math.pi/2
    if s2<=arc:
        a=s2/R  # turn right
        return Vector((R-R*math.cos(a), R*math.sin(a),0)), -a
    s3=s2-arc
    return Vector((R+s3, R, 0)), -math.pi/2
TOTAL=L1+R*math.pi/2+L3
def fwd(h): return Vector((-math.sin(h), math.cos(h),0))
def right(h): return Vector((math.cos(h), math.sin(h),0))

def link(ob,col=None):
    sc.collection.objects.link(ob); return ob
def ribbon(name,offA,offB,z,m,s0=-10,s1=TOTAL+15,step=0.75,segmat=None):
    bm=bmesh.new(); prev=None; n=int((s1-s0)/step)+1
    for i in range(n):
        s=s0+i*step
        if s<0: p,h=Vector((0,-L1+s,0)),0.0
        elif s>TOTAL: p,h=Vector((R+L3+(s-TOTAL),R,0)),-math.pi/2
        else: p,h=center(s)
        r=right(h)
        a=bm.verts.new(p+r*offA+Vector((0,0,z))); b=bm.verts.new(p+r*offB+Vector((0,0,z)))
        if prev:
            f=bm.faces.new((prev[0],prev[1],b,a))
            if segmat: f.material_index=(i//2)%2
        prev=(a,b)
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    for x in ([m] if not segmat else segmat): me.materials.append(x)
    ob=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me); return link(ob)

ground=bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=300,location=(10,0,-0.02)); g=bpy.context.object; g.name="Grass"; g.data.materials.append(M["Grass"])
ribbon("Track",-6,6,0,M["Asphalt"])
ribbon("Kerb_Inner",6,7.2,0.01,None,s0=L1-8,s1=L1+R*math.pi/2+8,step=1.0,segmat=[M["KerbRed"],M["KerbWhite"]])
ribbon("Kerb_Outer",-7.2,-6,0.01,None,s0=L1-8,s1=L1+R*math.pi/2+8,step=1.0,segmat=[M["KerbRed"],M["KerbWhite"]])
ribbon("Line_L",-5.6,-5.3,0.005,M["Line"]); ribbon("Line_R",5.3,5.6,0.005,M["Line"])
# start line
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=1,location=(0,-30,0.006)); s=bpy.context.object; s.name="StartLine"; s.scale=(11,0.8,1); s.data.materials.append(M["Line"])
# barrier on outside of corner (left side)
bm=bmesh.new(); prev=None
for i in range(0,int((TOTAL+10)/1.0)):
    p,h=center(min(i*1.0,TOTAL)) if i*1.0<=TOTAL else (Vector((R+L3+(i-TOTAL),R,0)),-math.pi/2)
    r=right(h); base=p-r*10
    v=[bm.verts.new(base+Vector((0,0,0))),bm.verts.new(base+Vector((0,0,1.0)))]
    if prev: bm.faces.new((prev[0],v[0],v[1],prev[1]))
    prev=v
me=bpy.data.meshes.new("Barrier"); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free(); me.materials.append(M["Barrier"])
bo=link(bpy.data.objects.new("Barrier",me)); sm=bo.modifiers.new("solid","SOLIDIFY"); sm.thickness=0.4
print(TOTAL)

import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector
sc=bpy.context.scene
M=bpy.data.materials
root=bpy.data.objects.new("RaceCar",None); sc.collection.objects.link(root); root.empty_display_size=1

def loft(name, sections, m):
    # sections: list of (y, [(x,z),...]) symmetric profile given half (x>=0) from bottom to top
    bm=bmesh.new(); rings=[]
    for y,half in sections:
        pts=[(x,z) for x,z in half]+[(-x,z) for x,z in reversed(half)]
        rings.append([bm.verts.new((x,y,z)) for x,z in pts])
    n=len(rings[0])
    for a,b in zip(rings,rings[1:]):
        for i in range(n):
            bm.faces.new((a[i],a[(i+1)%n],b[(i+1)%n],b[i]))
    bm.faces.new(list(reversed(rings[0]))); bm.faces.new(rings[-1])
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm,faces=bm.faces)
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free(); me.materials.append(m)
    ob=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me); sc.collection.objects.link(ob); ob.parent=root; return ob

# body: tail at y=-2.2 to nose y=2.3
body=loft("Car_Body",[
 (-2.2,[(0.95,0.25),(0.95,0.75),(0.7,0.85)]),
 (-1.0,[(1.0,0.2),(1.0,0.8),(0.75,0.95)]),
 (0.6,[(0.95,0.2),(0.95,0.7),(0.6,0.8)]),
 (1.6,[(0.85,0.18),(0.85,0.5),(0.45,0.58)]),
 (2.35,[(0.6,0.16),(0.6,0.28),(0.3,0.32)]),
],M["CarBody"])
cab=loft("Car_Canopy",[
 (-1.3,[(0.7,0.9),(0.55,1.05)]),
 (-0.5,[(0.68,0.92),(0.5,1.28)]),
 (0.3,[(0.64,0.85),(0.42,1.22)]),
 (0.9,[(0.6,0.78),(0.35,0.85)]),
],M["Glass"])
# accent stripe / splitter
def box(name,loc,size,m,rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1,location=loc,rotation=rot); o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name
    o.scale=size; bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True); o.data.materials.append(M[m]); o.parent=root; return o
box("Car_Splitter",(0,2.35,0.13),(1.5,0.4,0.05),"CarAccent")
box("Car_Stripe",(0,0.2,0.86),(0.35,3.0,0.02),"CarAccent",rot=(math.radians(-4),0,0))
box("Car_Diffuser",(0,-2.25,0.3),(1.7,0.15,0.15),"Tire")
# rear wing
box("Car_Wing",(0,-2.0,1.35),(2.0,0.5,0.06),"CarAccent",rot=(math.radians(-8),0,0))
for x in (-0.95,0.95):
    box("Car_WingPlate",(x,-2.0,1.25),(0.05,0.6,0.35),"CarBody")
for x in (-0.4,0.4):
    box("Car_WingStrut",(x,-1.95,1.05),(0.06,0.15,0.45),"Tire")
# side intakes
for x in (-1.0,1.0):
    box("Car_Intake",(x*1.0,-0.4,0.5),(0.06,0.7,0.25),"Tire")
# wheels
wheels=[]
for i,(x,y) in enumerate([(-0.95,1.45),(0.95,1.45),(-1.0,-1.35),(1.0,-1.35)]):
    r=0.36 if y>0 else 0.38
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=10,radius=r,depth=0.34,location=(x,y,r),rotation=(0,math.pi/2,0))
    w=bpy.context.object; w.name=f"Car_Wheel_{i}"; w.data.materials.append(M["Tire"]); w.parent=root
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(rotation=True)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=6,radius=r*0.6,depth=0.36,location=(x,y,r),rotation=(0,math.pi/2,0))
    h=bpy.context.object; h.name=f"Car_Hub_{i}"; h.data.materials.append(M["Rim"]); bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(rotation=True)
    h.parent=w; h.location=(0,0,0); h.matrix_parent_inverse.identity()
    # move hub to wheel local: hub mesh centered at world loc; reset
    for v in h.data.vertices: v.co -= Vector((x,y,r))
    for v in w.data.vertices: v.co -= Vector((x,y,r))
    w.location=(x,y,r); h.location=(0,0,0)
    wheels.append((w,r))
for o in root.children: o.select_set(False)
print([o.name for o in root.children])

    s2=s-L1; arc=R*math.pi/2
    if s2<=arc:
